description: Elektroenergetyka i ciepłownictwo polskie is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstwo Energii. Zestawienie zawiera podstawowe informacje dotyczące: • Krajowego systemu elektroenergetycznego (tabl. 1): moc zainstalowana i osiągalna na koniec roku; zapotrzebowanie mocy przy 50 Hz; wielkość produkcji energii elektrycznej; import i eksport energii elektrycznej; zużycie energii elektrycznej. • Bilansu energii elektrycznej elektroenergetyki zawodowej (tabl. Coverage: Ministerstwo Energii. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstwo Energii. Its keywords include elektroenergetyka, ciepłownictwo. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2025-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
